subject: Re: Nimbus — advance collection schedule and tax routing
messages:
From: Suzanne Price <suzanne.price@nimbusretail.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Annual advance collection proposal and operational ask

Hi Hannah and Karthik,

Thanks again for the call this week. Attached is the proposed advance (prepay) schedule for our annual commitment — we split the total committed USD amount into 4 equal tranches, billed at the start of each quarter and swept monthly into the Redwood escrow account. High-level asks:

- Can Redwood invoice on our US entity (Nimbus US) but route VAT evidence back to our UK VAT registration?
- We need a playbook for monthly drawdowns and a single point-of-contact for collections.
- DocuSign MOU is attached for signature.

Attachments: nimbus_proposed_prepay_schedule.xlsx, signed_mou.pdf

Let me know what you need from our side to finalize the schedule.

Best,
Suzanne Price
Head of Finance, Nimbus Retail

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Suzanne Price <suzanne.price@nimbusretail.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Annual advance collection proposal and operational ask

Suzanne — thanks for the file. Quick confirmation items before we lock the flow:

1) VAT routing: we can invoice Nimbus US and mark the invoices for VAT evidence to your UK VAT number, but we need the VAT certificate and a contact who owns cross-border tax. Can you provide the certificate and preferred email for follow-up?

2) Sweep cadence: you mentioned "swept monthly from tranche" — is the expectation that the tranche funds are deposited once per quarter and then Redwood triggers monthly withdrawals against usage until the tranche is exhausted? Please confirm.

3) SLA for collections: what is your desired window for us to apply funds to invoices once they hit the escrow account? We typically show funds applied same-day if received by 5pm PT.

I'll draft a short collection runbook and share with Karthik & Laura for ops sign-off.

Thanks,
Hannah
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Tom Grant <tom.grant@nimbusretail.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Annual advance collection proposal and operational ask

Hannah — quick clarifications from our treasury team:

- Yes, tranche is wired quarterly to Redwood escrow (ACH / Wire depending on country).
- Monthly sweeps: Nimbus expects Redwood to trigger a month-start transfer against the remaining tranche balance for that month’s usage forecast.
- SLA: Nimbus requests 48-hour confirmation of application to monthly invoices after funds land in escrow.

I've attached the signed MOU (for completeness). Also including Tom's direct line in case you need treasury coordination.

Attachments: signed_mou.pdf

Regards,
Tom Grant
Treasury Manager, Nimbus Retail

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood collection runbook (draft) + questions on VAT mapping

Team — I took Suzanne/Tom's inputs and sketched a draft runbook (see attachment). Key operational points:

- Inbound wiring: accounting ops will tag wires to deal id NW-2027-0483 and create an escrow ledger entry the same day.
- Monthly sweep trigger: automation will create a sweep job on the 1st of each month for the forecasted consumption; if forecast < actual usage we will escalate and pull additional funds up to tranche remaining.
- Apply window: finance to mark invoices as paid within 24 hours of funds posting (we can try same-day for domestic ACH). Nimbus asked for 48 hours; we should be able to meet that but need to confirm treasury timezone alignment.
- VAT: We need the UK VAT certificate and the customer’s preferred tax contact. If VAT needs to route to UK entity, legal needs to confirm whether invoice needs to show UK registration or we attach evidence post-invoice.

Attachments: redwood_collection_runbook.docx

Please flag any operational gaps. I will version the doc after Laura confirms invoice numbering and Michael confirms ledger tags.

Thanks,
Karthik
Head of Billing Automation
Redwood Inference

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Suzanne Price <suzanne.price@nimbusretail.com>, Tom Grant <tom.grant@nimbusretail.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Annual advance collection proposal and operational ask

Suzanne / Tom — we can proceed with the proposed model with these confirmations from Redwood:

- Billing cadence: Redwood will issue invoices monthly, billed to Nimbus US, and mark each invoice with the deal id NW-2027-0483. Payments will be debited from the active tranche until depleted; when <10% tranche remains we will notify Nimbus and request the next tranche wire (or allow automatic top-up if you prefer).
- VAT: please send your UK VAT certificate and confirm the tax contact. Redwood will not change the legal invoicing entity without legal sign-off; we'll attach VAT evidence to the invoice package to satisfy your compliance needs.
- SLA: Redwood commits to applying funds to invoices within 24 hours of funds posting for domestic wires; will aim for 48 hours if cross-border delays occur.

I've attached a short CSV template for VAT evidence requests — if you can populate and return by EOD Monday we’ll finish the legal/tax mapping and push the runbook to final.

Attachments: VAT_evidence_request.csv

Next steps for Nimbus: send VAT certificate + completed VAT_evidence_request.csv; for Redwood: Karthik to finalize runbook and Michael to prepare ledger tags and invoice templates.

Best,
Hannah

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Suzanne Price <suzanne.price@nimbusretail.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 17:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Annual advance collection proposal and operational ask — final items

Suzanne — looping back with final operational items and links.

1) Invoice templates: shared in Drive here: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/NW-2027-0483/invoice-templates (includes invoice numbering scheme, PO mapping and sample JSON payload for our API).
2) DocuSign: we received the signed MOU; if you can re-confirm that wired tranche will include reference NW-2027-0483 that will help automatic ledger mapping.
3) VAT certificate: please send the scanned certificate to finance@nimbusretail.com and copy us so we can attach evidence.

We've committed to the 24-hour apply SLA for domestic wires and will treat the 48-hour cross-border SLA as acceptable if you expect delays. Karthik will publish the final runbook by Monday and Michael will seed the ledger tags.

Attached: invoice_templates-drive-link.txt (link + short readme)

Thanks — looking forward to getting the first tranche set up.

Laura Bennett
Senior Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
